arguments.value: Ask the user to run `bcdedit /enum all` and, for each EFI System Partition they want to inspect, mount that partition and run `bcdedit /store <mounted-drive>:\EFI\Microsoft\Boot\BCD /enum` to confirm which BCD store belongs to which drive.

raw: {"value":"Ask the user to run `bcdedit /enum all` and, for each EFI System Partition they want to inspect, mount that partition and run `bcdedit /store <mounted-drive>:\\EFI\\Microsoft\\Boot\\BCD /enum` to confirm which BCD store belongs to which drive."}
